leadText:
Mamie (Japanese: マミイ Mamie) is a character of the day who appeared in For The Love of Meowth!.

Mamie is a traveling Pokémon Trainer who came across an unconscious after he was separated following a blast off. When he came to, he fell head over heels in love with her . Jessie and James soon found him and thanked Mamie for looking after him, before dragging Meowth off. A little while later, Mamie met up with and . She informed them that she was collecting Gym Badges, having previously challenged and lost to Crasher Wake. As the group and Mamie crossed a bridge, they fell into a trap set by Team Rocket, who took Glameow away from her.

Mamie was aided by Ash and his friends in the search for Glameow. They soon found Jessie and James, but they revealed that Meowth ran off with Glameow. When Meowth was found, he refused to give Glameow back to Mamie or surrender her to Team Rocket. When James accidentally hit Glameow with 's , she unexpectedly evolved into . No longer attracted to her, Meowth gave up Purugly, who returned to Mamie. She commanded Purugly to use on Team Rocket, sending them blasting off.

Mamie thanked Ash and the others before once again heading to Pastoria City to challenge Crasher Wake to a rematch.
